lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately 5-6 distinct vertical columns of high-intensity white circular clusters are visible posterior to the gills, forming a semi-regular grid pattern with higher luminance concentrations in the mid-lateral zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands intersect the horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a checkerboard-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank; each ridge exhibits a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high reflectance on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated teleost fish (likely remoras) are visible near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and along the ventral-lateral silhouette.
